subject.name: Property tests for posting changes
subject.summary: Every change under src/ledgerly/ledger ships a hypothesis property test asserting postings sum to zero
subject.description: Testing preference for the ledger core: property-based tests with hypothesis for any change to posting, journal or balance code; the invariant is that every transfer's postings sum to zero and balances are reproducible from the journal. Synonyms: property-based testing, hypothesis, ledger invariants, test policy.

properties.prescription: Add or extend a hypothesis property test that asserts postings sum to zero for any change under src/ledgerly/ledger

operations.description: Stated by Priya in CONTRIBUTING.md; applies to everything under src/ledgerly/ledger
